mcp_tools.name: dependency_governance_audit
mcp_tools.title: Dependency governance audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a dependency-governance evidence manifest; get a deterministic GOVERNED / NOT_GOVERNED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections (justification, verified sources, pinning, audit and updates, licences, SBOM) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The dependency-governance evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All 21 boolean checks pass; non-permissive and notice requirements are satisfied by their respective human_decision_recorded and notice_updated fields.
